thread:
Maya (Docs): Quick heads-up 1 - doing a short sweep of live docs PRs. Found mixed usage: "model", "model_name", "model_id" and inconsistent phrasing like "the model version" vs "revision". We should converge.
Theo (Eng): Agreed. Backend canonical is `model_id` and we also have `variant_tag` in telemetry.
Ivy (PM): Need a concise migration blurb we can link in release notes. Also want to avoid breaking examples in tutorials.
Maya (Docs): Proposal: docs terminology = `model_family` (human-facing), `model_id` (API identifier), `variant` (performance/quantization). Use `revision` only for major public releases.
Theo (Eng): OK. Server can accept `model` as alias for now and emit an INFO deprecation log. We'll leave alias for 8 weeks.
DevEx (bot): Repo scan: 21 JS/TS snippets use `model:` in examples.
Maya (Docs): I'll update glossary + style guide note: "Prefer explicit identifier names; avoid generic 'the model'." I'll add a one-liner migration snippet for PR templates.
Ivy (PM): Deprecation plan: 2-week soft warning, 6-week removal (adjustable for enterprise). I'll draft comms.
Theo (Eng): Example change for snippets:
```js
// old
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b' })
// new
await client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood-7b', variant: 'v1-quant' })
```
Maya (Docs): Great. Action items: Maya -> glossary + PR template snippet; Theo -> server warning + update a couple canonical SDK examples; DevEx -> run bulk replace on examples and open follow-up PRs. Ivy -> final timeline and release note.
Maya (Docs): I'll also fix the broken glossary anchor flagged by the link checker and add redirects where possible. Follow-up after PRs land. :sparkles:
